text: Assumption: In software architectures with disabled C++ exception handling, the function is not callable at compile time — is this correct?

norm: in software architectures with disabled c exception handling the function is not callable at compile time
assumption: In software architectures with disabled C++ exception handling, the function is not callable at compile time.
rationale: According to SWS_CORE_10304, the method does not participate in overload resolution when exceptions are disabled in the toolchain.
